title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The playing time question
hook: A parent asks why their kid sat so long.
intro: The message comes in that night.
Their child played less than others.
statement: Playing time questions are easier with a plan you shared early.
q1: Do you explain your playing time plan in detail —
q2: or keep it short and invite them to talk?
q3: Did they know your approach before the season?
t1: Both can work. But these talks go better
t2: when your plan was clear from the start.
cta: Coaches — how do you answer playing time questions?
ctaLines: Share the plan. Talk in person. Wait a day.
Explain in full or keep it brief?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent asks why their kid sat so long.
The message comes in that night. Their child played less than others.
Playing time questions are easier with a plan you shared early.
Explain it in full or keep it brief. Both can work.
How do you answer playing time questions? Share your habit in the comments.
